correctness.rationale: Re-ran all certificates live: dihedral.py -> DIHEDRAL_OK (8/8 pairwise inequivalent, base orbits disjoint, orbit sizes 4,8,4,2,4,8,4,2); vacuity.py -> VACUITY_OK (M0,M1,M2,M3,M5,M6 each exactly 1 constrained order yielding base pattern; M4/M7 yielding 0132/1023); verify.py -> VERIFY_OK with AGREEMENT 80/80, collapse pairs exactly the 6 among M0-M3 plus M5-M6, AV10 1072110/586590=1.827699>=1.5, mesh>=classical sanity, classical rows B0=[1,2,6,23,103,513,2762,15793,94776,591950] B1=[1,2,6,23,103,513,2761,15767,94359,586590] identical across routes. Manually audited both C enumerators: rank-counting vs chained-comparison classical tests both correct for 1324 (a<c<b<d) and 2143 (b<a<d<c); mesh cell bounds xlo/xhi/ylo/yhi correct for 0-based values; shading tests correct because no occurrence point can lie strictly inside its own cell (x-coordinate argument: no I[k] strictly between consecutive I's), so Route A skip vs Route B full count are equivalent; occ buffer 300>C(10,4)=210 safe; counts fit in long. Vacuity Lemma verified as proof not just enumeration: minimal-i1 / minimal-i2-then-maximal-i1 / minimal-i3 measures strictly improve (j<i1; same i2 larger i1 with j in (i1,i2); j<i3 with j in (i2,i3) and indices ordered), and replacement patterns machine-checked over all 120 relative orders. Distinguishes proof (all-n coincidence) from experimental evidence (80-cell table, finite ratio). Two deviations disclosed in DRAFT 6 and do not break correctness: Route B is second brute force not transfer-matrix (weaker method independence but still implementation independence with different generation, tests, sorting, quadruple order) plus third Python spot-check and OEIS anchors; no asymptotic growth theorem claimed (ratio is finite-window). One inessential gloss error: M4 witness (0,2,1,4,3) parenthetical says 'corner region x<1 is empty' but region x<1,y<1 contains (0,0), so sole occurrence is shaded (which is why permutation is mesh-avoiding and Av5=104>103). Permutation itself and conclusion are correct; gloss inversion does not affect counts or Lemma.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Hilmarsson et al. 1409.3165 starts Wilf-classification of length-2 meshes only (1024 patterns to <=65 then 56, conjectured 46) - different length and bases, no 1324/2143 single-shadings, no 80-cell table. Tannock-Ulfarsson 1704.07104 classifies length-2 meshes under dominating length-3 constraint / inside 231-avoiding - disjoint scope from unrestricted length-4 mesh avoidance. Albert et al. math/0502504 gives classical 4231 Wilf-Stanley limit >=9.35 via automata - classical length-4 only, no mesh decoration. Kitaev-Liese 1209.6423 studies eight small-length meshes (p,q1,q2,s1,s2,s3,t1,t2) with harmonic/Catalan results and one q1~q2 equivalence - different bases/lengths, establishes 8-pattern census as citable unit but does not record W. No source records W, its 10-term rows, M0-vs-M3 corner-vs-central collapse, or M4-vs-M5/M6 ratio 1.827. Vacuity coincidences M0-M3~1324 and M5-M6~2143 are not mechanically implied by length-2 or classical bounds (added shading constraints change avoidance; replacement argument is base- and cell-specific, correctly failing for M4/M7). No prior length-4 single-shading census found.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline judged separately from unfinished survey: Lemma proves six single-shaded length-4 meshes coincide with classical 1324/2143 for ALL n (dihedrally-inequivalent Wilf-collapse, headline M0 corner (0,0) vs M3 central (2,2)), and dual-certified table gives exact Av_n for two genuinely restrictive meshes M4/M7 to n=10 with finite-window separation 1072110/586590=1.827699>=1.5. Object motivated before computation (minimal single-cell decorations of 1324 hard vs 2143 separable-type, dihedral-reduced, n=8..10 regularity boundary in Wilf/mesh program of Knuth/Simion-Schmidt/Marcus-Tardos; length-2 now closed at 46 classes, length-4 open). Values not known or mechanically implied; future researcher can need precise rows/coincidences as calibration for Stanley-Wilf estimators, regularity tests, Wilf-decision procedures. Narrow exact datum explicitly allowed: rigorously established invariant of natural object. Incomplete aspects honestly disclosed (second brute force not transfer-matrix, only trivial n! upper bounds, no asymptotic rate, W-completeness not certified) cannot be called complete but do not erase headline exact result.
